front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏  系列《32》

en: The flowering tree in the dream
Following the fine rain of late spring
Blooming all along the way
The painting, brush not yet touched to it
White egrets on paper, scattering
Flying into slanting wind and fine rain

points.zh:
西塞山前白鷺飛
桃花流水鱖魚肥
青箬笠，綠蓑衣
斜風細雨不須歸
--宋。張志和《漁歌子》
points.en:
Before Mount Xisai, egrets fly;
peach blossoms drift on the flowing water where mandarin fish grow fat.
A green bamboo hat, a green straw raincoat —
in the slanting wind and fine rain, there is no need to return.
-- Tang Dynasty. Zhang Zhihe, "Fisherman's Song"

en: Cutting off a piece of the Aegean's blue
Set in the courtyard, Homer said
The wind chime rings, and myth arrives
A small street at dawn
The old man who sells soy milk
Scooping up a stretch of hardship-worn years
Sunset at the treetops
Flowers hide the level wilds, and farther still
A small boat rises and falls with the lake's water

points.zh:
「做完白日的工作，靠岸的小舟，靜聽湖水拍岸的節奏。」
--印度詩人泰戈爾 《漂鳥集》

en: Silvergrass paints the mountain ridge white
In the far distance of the years
Who is calling?
The bell's toll lingers, slow
Upon the reeds, reddened
Yesterday's setting sun

zh: 楚河楚河楚河楚河楚河楚河
逐漸消隱   逐漸消隱
en: Soldiers, soldiers, soldiers, soldiers, soldiers, soldiers, soldiers, soldiers
Chu River, Chu River, Chu River, Chu River, Chu River, Chu River
Gradually fading from view, gradually fading from view

points.zh:
「 老兵不死，只是消隱 」
麥克阿瑟美國國會演說，1951年4月19日
I am closing my 52 years of military service. When I joined the Army, even before the turn of the century, it was the fulfillment of all of my boyish hopes and dreams. The world has turned over many times since I took the oath on the plain at West Point, and the hopes and dreams have long since vanished, but I still remember the refrain of one of the most popular barrack ballads of that day which proclaimed most proudly that "old soldiers never die; they just fade away."

zh: 楚河楚河楚河楚河楚河楚河
暮色遲遲  暮色遲遲
en: tramp tramp tramp tramp tramp tramp tramp tramp
Chu River, Chu River, Chu River, Chu River, Chu River, Chu River
Dusk lingers slow, dusk lingers slow

points.zh:
寒蟬悽切，對長亭晚，驟雨初歇。都門帳飲無緒，留戀處，蘭舟催發。執手相看淚眼，竟無語凝噎。念去去，千里煙波，暮靄沉沉楚天闊。
多情自古傷離別，更那堪冷落清秋節！ 今宵酒醒何處？ 楊柳岸，曉風殘月。此去經年，應是良辰好景虛設。便縱有千種風情，更與何人說？
--宋。柳永 《雨霖鈴. 寒蟬悽切》
points.en:
The cicadas cry mournfully and forlorn; facing the wayside pavilion at dusk, a sudden shower has just stopped. Drinking half-heartedly under a tent at the city gate, lingering in reluctance, yet the orchid boat urges departure. Hand in hand, we gaze at each other with tearful eyes, too choked to speak. I think of the journey ahead — a thousand miles of misty waves, the evening haze hanging heavy over the vast southern sky.
Since ancient times, the passionate have grieved at parting; how much harder still in this bleak and desolate autumn! Where will I wake from wine tonight? Perhaps by a willow bank, under a fading moon at dawn wind. Years will pass from this departure; even fine seasons and lovely sights will be spent in vain. Even if there is a thousand kinds of tender feeling, to whom could I ever tell it?
-- Song dynasty. Liu Yong, 'Rain on the Bells (Yulinling): The Cicadas Cry Mournfully'

flow.caption_zh: 人生如棋    何不瀟灑走一回

points.zh:
《瀟灑走一回》
詞：陳樂融/王蕙玲    曲：陳大力/陳秀男 
天地悠悠  過客匆匆  潮起又潮落
恩恩怨怨  生死白頭  幾人能看透

紅塵啊滾滾  痴痴啊情深  聚散終有時
留一半清醒  留一半醉   至少夢裡有你追隨

我拿青春賭明天   你用真情換此生
歲月不知人間    多少的憂傷  何不瀟灑走一回
